deck_title: Slide90 P0: an executable foundation for decision-ready slides
decision: Accept the P0 contract and extend future layouts through the same interface

slides.title: Four executable capabilities move Slide90 from a prompt pattern to a testable product
slides.subtitle: The P0 case rests on a stable contract, a unified interface, editable output, and reproducible quality checks.

blocks.title: Stable deck-spec contract
blocks.body: Separate agent judgment from deterministic production with one validated JSON interface.
blocks.evidence: Draft 2020-12 schema defines slides, metrics, blocks, evidence, roles, and sources.

blocks.title: One validation and render CLI
blocks.body: Give every agent platform the same commands and failure behavior.
blocks.evidence: The slide90 binary validates first and rejects unsupported render layouts explicitly.

blocks.title: Editable PowerPoint output
blocks.body: Render repeatable geometry without flattening the page into an image.
blocks.evidence: Evidence matrix and capability loop use native PowerPoint shapes, text, and connectors.

blocks.title: Reproducible quality loop
blocks.body: Catch structural errors before drawing and visual failures before release.
blocks.evidence: Tests, office rendering, overflow checks, independent import, and benchmark all pass.

slides.conclusion: P0 establishes a public, testable contract that future layouts can extend without changing the agent workflow.

slides.title: Six contributor roles connect real reporting needs to a tested public release
slides.subtitle: The loop keeps user context at the front, stable interfaces in the middle, and measurable quality at the end.

blocks.title: Issue reporter
blocks.body:
Name the management question
Attach a synthetic failure case

blocks.title: Layout contributor
blocks.body:
Map the reading order
Provide a safe visual example

blocks.title: Spec maintainer
blocks.body:
Review schema changes
Protect backward compatibility

blocks.title: Renderer maintainer
blocks.body:
Implement native objects
Preserve tested geometry

blocks.title: QA maintainer
blocks.body:
Run render and overflow tests
Review the public preview

blocks.title: Release maintainer
blocks.body:
Check privacy and licensing
Publish package and results

slides.conclusion: Contributors supply validated needs; maintainers protect the contract, renderer, quality bar, and public release.
